bone_edge_roundoff_repair.scope: Roundoff-scale Boolean intersections snapped to their source bone edge; original unmodified v7 correspondence preserved separately.

limitations: Individual closed regions overlap intentionally at junction. No conforming common tissue mesh exists yet.
Only mandibular depressor and original zygomatic reference have explicit bone footprints. Other cut ends are unbound.

Existing earlier cheek equilibrium is not transferred onto this new assembly.
All coordinates and thicknesses are authored estimates, guided by cited layer relations.
